heading: ITR Login Password Reset: Alternatives Without Aadhaar OTP
tldr: If you've forgotten your Income Tax e-filing portal password, several methods allow you to reset it.
You can regain access even if you don't have your Aadhaar-linked mobile number handy.
Net Banking is a common and secure method to reset your password directly from your bank's portal.
A Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) provides another robust option for password reset, especially for businesses.
Utilising a pre-set secret question or an OTP sent to your e-filing registered email/mobile also works.
caption:
Forgot your Income Tax e-filing password and your Aadhaar-linked phone is missing? Don't worry! There are easy ways to get back into your account. You can use your bank's net banking, a digital signature, or even a secret question you set up. This means less stress during tax season for you. Learn all the simple steps to reset your password in our latest article.
